In about [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], shortly after the conclusion of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] student [[Len Markus]] traveled to the [[Heart Tree]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] to search for the [[Eye of the Sun]], an ancient [[Jedi artifact/Legends|Jedi artifact]]. However, [[Gender/Legends|he]] and his force of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] were '''confronted''' by a group of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]] that sought to destroy the [[Darkstaff]], a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]] that had possessed Markus and was guiding his actions. Markus used the staff to summon 12 [[Kilassin]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] of large lizard, to fight for him, and he then engaged the agents in combat. However, the summoning of the creatures created an imbalance in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and in response, the Heart Tree called upon a [[King Kilassin|giant Kilassin]] to fight on behalf of the agents. The Heroes of Cularin eventually defeated Markus' forces and one of the agents voluntarily sacrificed themselves to the Darkstaff and channeled the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side of the Force]] into it, which destroyed the artifact.
